findings.message: The received file has the required 1536x1024 landscape canvas, no alpha channel, exactly three separated studies, no characters, no story action, and no generated labels or dialogue.
The prior color-format blocker is resolved. The PNG is encoded as true single-channel grayscale with mode L, pixel extrema 0-255, and no alpha channel.

The core manga-finish direction now passes. The sheet uses open white surfaces, selective dark shapes, flatter lighting, matte bounded puddles without mirrored architecture, and clearer tonal separation. Dense roof and ironwork detail is now localized rather than spread uniformly across every surface.
Repeated arched windows, tiled wall bands, iron columns, roof structure, clocks, and the Cafe Siete grille establish a coherent single station across all three views.

The large ticket-hall clock still clearly reads about 12:05: the minute hand points to numeral I. It does not show the required 12:07 position between I and II and visibly past I. This locked story-time requirement is the only remaining visual blocker.

Roof and ironwork line density remains high, but it is sufficiently localized and contrasted by open white walls and floors to function as non-blocking environment-reference detail. A correction must not increase this density or reintroduce all-over engraving texture.

No v005 image job or ChatGPT handoff was released. The file is accepted as an author-submitted manual retry for review, but its exact external prompt and attachment use cannot be independently verified from the PNG.
No image was edited, filtered, regenerated, converted, renamed, or promoted during review. Byte-identical copies are retained only as review evidence and targeted correction input.
